method: e-rara OAI-PMH oai_dc (sets zuz, landkarten, cartesgeneve, museecarto) for discovery → IIIF Presentation 2.0 manifest per title for verbatim title, imprint, creators, holding institution, shelfmark, rights, thumbnail, canvas count and the stated "Kartendaten" extent, plus the provider's own canonical viewer URL from the DOI landing page (og:url); e-rara SRU 1.2 (CQL via dc.title/dc.subject) for the Zürich plan, Zürich-region, Zürich city-plan and Europe/world overview material the sorted OAI paging does not reach, each hit confirmed by OAI GetRecord and its manifest: the Zürich sets keep only records whose stated extent centre lies inside the canton of Zürich's window, the overview set only records whose centre lies outside it and whose extent spans at least 5°; swisstopo WMTS 1.0.0 GetCapabilities for the Zeitreise, Siegfriedkarte and SWISSIMAGE Zeitreise editions and for the comparison layers in overlays.json. No title, date, coordinate or holding library is invented: a record whose library is not stated by the manifest or by its catalogue corpus is dropped and listed in `skipped`. Regenerate with: node scripts/fetch-records.mjs --out public/data

e-rara:zuz.rule: maps only, one entry per sheet, publication year ≤ 1900, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox; only sheets of the 1:25 000 Wildkarte series (title-anchored) are kept, because the collection is that series — the set is the library's whole corpus, so other maps it holds (e.g. the 1546–1590 cosmography volumes) are listed in `notWildkarte` instead of being miscredited to the series

e-rara:landkarten.rule: every map of the set that is not a series volume (the set states 2335 records; the first 30 OAI pages = 300 records are read); the candidate window is the union of the 50 oldest candidates of the set's first 12 OAI pages (the window this set was first harvested with, so the deeper read does not lose that reach) and 90 candidates evenly spaced over the year-sorted candidates (so the four centuries are reachable instead of one decade); requires a stated Kartendaten bbox, one entry per leading title (60 characters); kept as the union of two documented passes — the oldest 26 records that pass the gates (the earlier selection rule: the cantonal and regional sheets outside Zürich) and a per-decade spread with at most three records per publication decade (cap 44), which is what brings the 16th–18th-century Zürich sheets in

e-rara:cartesgeneve.rule: map records of the set, oldest first, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox

e-rara:museecarto.rule: map records of the set, oldest first, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox and a holding library stated by the manifest or by its catalogue corpus

e-rara:sru-zurich-plans.cantonWindowSource: swisstopo SearchServer, type=locations&origins=kantone (GG25 canton layer): the centre of the record's own stated extent must lie inside it
e-rara:sru-zurich-plans.rule: map genre, a stated year and a stated MODS coordinates statement in the SRU record, then confirmed by OAI GetRecord and a IIIF manifest that states the holding institution and a Kartendaten extent; one entry per title and year across all SRU sets, oldest first, cap 48 — every candidate the two queries answer (92) is pooled, and 47 of them pass the gates (the rest are duplicate editions, series volumes without a stated extent or candidates without a stated year), so no productive decade is cut off

e-rara:sru-zurich-region.cantonWindowSource: swisstopo SearchServer, type=locations&origins=kantone (GG25 canton layer): the centre of the record's own stated extent must lie inside it
e-rara:sru-zurich-region.rule: same gates as the Zürich plan set (map genre, stated year, stated MODS coordinates, OAI GetRecord + IIIF manifest with a stated holding institution and Kartendaten extent), the centre of the stated extent must lie inside the canton window, titles already kept by another set are skipped, one entry per title and year, oldest first with at most three records per publication decade so one productive decade cannot crowd out the range

e-rara:sru-zurich-city-plans.cantonWindowSource: swisstopo SearchServer, type=locations&origins=kantone (GG25 canton layer): the centre of the record's own stated extent must lie inside it
e-rara:sru-zurich-city-plans.rule: same gates as the other SRU sets, the centre of the stated extent must lie inside the canton window, one entry per title and year, oldest first with at most three records per publication decade — a third set on purpose: a 1705 fortress plan and a 1838 city plan are the same kind of “small area, one sheet” object and would otherwise displace each other inside one decade of a single set

e-rara:sru-world-overview.cantonWindowSource: swisstopo SearchServer, type=locations&origins=kantone (GG25 canton layer): the centre of the record's own stated extent must lie OUTSIDE it (mirror image of the Zürich sets; without the window the set is skipped)
e-rara:sru-world-overview.rule: same gates as the other SRU sets (map genre, stated year, stated MODS coordinates, OAI GetRecord + IIIF manifest with a stated holding institution and Kartendaten extent); the centre of the stated extent must lie OUTSIDE the canton window — the mirror image of the Zürich sets, so one keyword hit cannot appear in both — and the extent must span at least 5° of latitude or longitude, which is what makes it an overview map instead of a local sheet; one entry per title and year, at most three records per publication decade. The pool is round-robined over the queries so a keyword that answers many hits (Deutschland) cannot crowd out the others, and a per-query quota of 7 bounds each keyword; the continent/world, country and region keywords are pooled together (7-21: 20 queries, incl. the non-European Südamerika, Palästina, Türkei, Indien, Nordamerika, Russland, Syrien, Japan)

swisstopo:zeitreise.rule: curated Zeitreise editions (exact or nearest advertised Time value)

swisstopo:hiks-siegfried.rule: one record per decade advertised in the Siegfriedkarte Time dimension (1870–1949)

swisstopo:swissimage-1946.rule: the dedicated SWISSIMAGE 1946 historical aerial layer
